hint_1: Chalked on the wall: Air first, or the fire eats you. Then the fire, then the coal. Then the bill.
hint_2: A shift rhyme scratched into the coal: Tuesday's for sweat and Payday's a lie, Wednesday's for coughing and Monday we die. Sung backwards, apparently.

lines: A tally tag hung on a pit prop like a medal. 'TUCK, No. 5'. The prop is holding up the roof. Mostly out of habit.
You pocket the tag. It is lighter than it should be.
A tally tag in a lunch tin. The lunch is eleven years old and has developed opinions. 'ROSA, No. 7'.
You pocket the tag. It is lighter than it should be.
A tally tag nailed over a list of wages, as if to hide the sum. 'BERT, No. 4'.
You pocket the tag. It is lighter than it should be.
A tally tag on Overman Slagg's desk, used to stir his tea. 'ODO, No. 2'. The tea is mostly brass by now.
You pocket the tag. It is lighter than it should be.

tag_empty: A clean square in the coal dust where a tag lay.

lines: A note pinned to a prop, in a hand you know from three races: 'S. - I'll send the rookie down the right gallery. Bring the net. Per head, as agreed. J.'
An auction book: 'Tull, cottage, sale the day after the service. Grice, cottage and curtains, SOLD. Pell, one barrow, no bids.' Signed: M.
Every name in the book is on one of Mercer's notices. Every one of them is alive.

auction_plain: A ledger of cottages sold after funerals. The funerals were all very well attended. By buyers.
sign: BELLOWS DEEP - LAST SHIFT DOWN: ELEVEN YEARS AGO. LAST SHIFT UP: PENDING.
brodie: Brodie: I work for Slagg. Officially I work for nobody. The pay is the same either way.
brodie_intro: Brodie: This mine is closed. So close your eyes and go away.
brodie_defeat: Brodie: Shut down. Like the mine. Allegedly.
fuse: Senna: I light the fuses. Short ones for rocks, long ones for questions.
fuse_intro: Senna: You've got a short fuse. Let's find out.
fuse_defeat: Senna: Fizzled. Happens to the best fuses.
weighman: Tolliver: I weigh the coal. The scale is honest. The weights are not.
weighman_intro: Tolliver: Let's see how much you weigh. Before and after.
weighman_defeat: Tolliver: Lighter than you looked. Like everyone's wages.
crabbe: Crabbe: I'm the foreman of a shift that doesn't exist, in a mine that's closed, for a clan that denies me. Very relaxing job.
crabbe_intro: Crabbe: Nobody gets to the bottom gallery. Slagg's orders. Slagg doesn't exist either.
crabbe_defeat: Crabbe: Go on down, then. Tell nobody I let you. Nobody will believe you anyway.
dorcas: Dorcas: I keep the lamps lit so the shift can see. Slagg keeps the shift so I can be paid. It's a circle. A grubby little circle.
dorcas_defeat: Dorcas: Lights on, then. You win. Mind the dark bits.
juno_4: Juno: Fourth time. I'm keeping count. You're keeping score. Nobody's keeping friends.
juno_4_intro: Juno: No more partners. Just rivals. It's more honest. I hate it.
juno_4_defeat: Juno: Four to nothing. Fine. Next act, I'm bringing a lawyer. Not Greaves. A real one.
